summary: Existing Coleto Creek coal power station (Goliad County) operated by Vistra Corp/Luminant. Vistra announced May 2024 coal-to-gas repower; coal retirement targeted 2027 per EPA rules; gas repower follows. Reported COD 2026-12-15 is physically impossible — no TCEQ NSR filed, no IA signed, coal plant still operating. Independent COD: 2028-Q2, high drift risk.

rationale: Coal retirement targeted 2027 per Vistra (EPA rules) — gas repower cannot operate before coal retires on same steam unit
No TCEQ NSR (new source review) filed for gas units as of 2026-07-19 — NSR + construction typically 18-24 months minimum
No IA signed; FIS not approved — contractual schedule not yet established
Vistra May 2024 PR and EnergyChoiceMatters confirm gas COD is 'after 2027 coal retirement'
EPA regional haze ruling Dec 2025 removed emission control mandates — may shift 2027 retirement date, but Vistra confirmed 'on-track' as of Sept 2025
Transco gas supply pipeline application (Mar 2026) shows supply planning underway but no approval confirmed
2026-12-15 queue COD appears to be an administrative placeholder inconsistent with any physical project schedule
